parameters.content:
## Transit pipeline (simple)

1. Pick the repo list (REPO_LIST_URL env, or the static list below)
2. For each repo run: `transit-repo/run-tools.sh` + `transit-repo/run-quality.sh`
3. Summarise what was produced.

No batching beyond batch=1, no fan-out, no resume: this is the "get it working" version.

parameters.command: ROOT="{{ $env.MULTITOOL_ROOT || '/opt/multi-tool' }}"; echo "=== SUMMARY ==="; ls "$ROOT/transit-repo/summary" 2>/dev/null; echo "=== ARTIFACT DIRS ==="; find "$ROOT/transit-repo/artifacts" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '; echo "=== QUALITY DIRS ==="; find "$ROOT/transit-repo/quality" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '
